decisions.value: Pre-authentication, redirected to the callback with state: invalid_request for an unknown or malformed organization ID, a name while names are off, organization sent to a deny client, require+no_prompt without organization, and any invitation parameter. A connection= not enabled for the organization (or unknown) gives no pre-authentication error.
decisions.local_default: After authentication: not a member and no auto-membership -> access_denied; third-party client with third_party_client_access block -> access_denied; no eligible organization in the picker -> access_denied; a connection outside the client/organization intersection is not offered and cannot be used to authenticate (hosted login refuses it with a page error). Unredirectable errors use the D-0026 error page.

decisions.value: No session: login_required for a valid organization; require+no_prompt without organization gives invalid_request (organization check runs before the login check).
decisions.local_default: Session user who is a member, or auto-membership can add, gets tokens silently; otherwise login_required. require+post_login_prompt without organization: silent if exactly one eligible organization, otherwise interaction_required.

decisions.topic: Tenant roles and direct permissions in an organization login
decisions.value: Not observable without an interactive login.
decisions.local_default: permissions is the union of tenant roles, direct permissions and the active organization's member roles, filtered by the API as in Plan 26.

decisions.value: Not observable without an interactive login.
decisions.local_default: Refresh token keeps its organization; each refresh re-checks organization existence and membership (failure invalid_grant, token not revoked); organization-role permissions recomputed.

decisions.value: Behavior is in the hosted flow; not observed.
decisions.local_default: No picker; the user logs in as an individual.

decisions.value: 400 on create (invalid_body) and on enabled-connection PATCH in both directions (setting signup true while assign is false, or assign false while signup is true).

decisions.topic: Password and device grants for a require client
decisions.value: Refused at client configuration: POST/PATCH /clients with organization_usage require while grant_types holds password, password-realm or device_code is 400, and adding those grants to a require client is 400. For deny/allow clients the grants work, ignore organization and never carry org_id/org_name. Token-time unauthorized_client remains only as defense in depth for stored legacy data.
^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,49}$: lowercase ASCII letters, digits, hyphen and underscore; starts with a letter or digit; 1-50 characters; same validator on create and PATCH; invalid 400 invalid_body.
Metadata 25 keys, keys 1-50 characters, values 1-255 characters; display_name 1-255; per_page/take 1-100; page window 1000 (400 invalid_paging beyond).
decisions.local_default: 10,000 organizations per tenant; 50 enabled connections per organization (10 at create, documented); 50 roles per member; unlimited members; organizations per user listed through pagination; 10 IDs per member/role batch.

decisions.value: Session behavior not observable without an interactive login. Observed separately: member role assignments survive membership removal and reappear when the user is re-added.
decisions.local_default: Removal affects only the next authorization or refresh; sessions stay valid for non-organization logins.

rules.name: name_format
rules.value: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,49}$; unique per tenant (409); rename by PATCH allowed

rules.name: organization_id_format
rules.value: org_ + 16 random ASCII alphanumerics; malformed path IDs are 400 invalid_uri

rules.name: display_name_default
rules.value: display_name defaults to name when omitted on create; empty display_name 400

rules.name: metadata_values
rules.value: values are non-empty strings of at most 255 characters; null, empty string and non-string values are 400 on create and PATCH (public schema allows null; observation wins); null and empty values carry no errorCode, non-string values are invalid_body

rules.name: metadata_keys
rules.value: at most 25 keys; key 1-50 characters matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9]\w*$; a key over 50 characters is 400 without errorCode, a pattern mismatch invalid_body

rules.name: branding_rules
rules.value: logo_url https only (null allowed by public schema); colors object needs both primary and page_background as HTML hex colors; colors {} is 400

rules.name: patch_replace
rules.value: PATCH replaces branding and metadata whole; {} or null clears them; omitted properties are untouched

rules.name: patch_empty_body
rules.value: PATCH /organizations/{id} with {} is 400; PATCH of an enabled connection with {} is 200 and unchanged

rules.name: get_omits_enabled_connections
rules.value: organization GET, by-name and list responses never contain enabled_connections; only the create response echoes them

rules.name: response_constant_fields
rules.value: third_party_client_access always present (default block); is_app_entitlement_active always present and false until Plan 30 (writes of true refused)

rules.name: delete_not_idempotent
rules.value: DELETE of an unknown or already deleted organization is 404; delete cascades connections, members and member roles

rules.name: malformed_id
rules.value: a path organization ID that is not org_-shaped is 400 invalid_uri; a well-formed unknown ID is 404

rules.name: list_default_order
rules.value: offset mode without sort: ascending name; checkpoint mode without sort: creation order; sort honored in both; from wins over page; invalid cursor 400

rules.name: members_fields
rules.value: fields from user_id,email,picture,name,roles; empty fields gives all except roles; fields with include_fields true/absent returns only those fields; include_fields=false excludes them; other names 400; roles [{id,name}], [] when none; roles needs read:organization_member_roles

rules.name: members_unknown_user
rules.value: POST members with any nonexistent user is 404 inexistent_user and adds nothing; already-present members are 204; empty array 400

rules.name: member_roles_non_member
rules.value: member role GET/POST for a user who is not a member is 404; DELETE for a nonexistent user is 404 inexistent_user

rules.name: member_roles_unknown_role
rules.value: POST member roles with an unknown role ID is 404; nothing is assigned

rules.name: member_role_retention
rules.value: removing a membership keeps the member's role assignments; re-adding the user restores them; tokens still need current membership; organization, user and role deletion remove them

rules.name: effective_roles_shape
rules.value: {roles:[{id,name,description,sources:["direct"]}],next?}; checkpoint from/take; direct roles only until groups (Plan 38); non-member 404

rules.name: role_members_shape
rules.value: {members:[{user_id,email,picture,name}],next?}; checkpoint only; include_totals and page/per_page ignored; unknown role 404; public lifecycle EA, included as the spec chose

rules.name: connection_flags
rules.value: assign_membership_on_login default false; is_signup_enabled default false, database only, requires assign_membership_on_login; show_as_button default true, false only on enterprise strategies (database 400); unknown connection 404 inexistent_connection; duplicate 409; camelCase or unknown properties 400; on enabled-connection PATCH the is_signup_enabled/assign_membership_on_login rule is 400 without errorCode (both directions), show_as_button invalid_body

rules.name: enabled_connection_delete
rules.value: DELETE of a connection not enabled for the organization is 204 when the connection exists and 404 inexistent_connection when it does not

rules.name: require_grant_conflict
rules.value: organization_usage require is incompatible with password, password-realm and device_code grants: 400 at client create/update in either order; token-time unauthorized_client is defense in depth only

rules.name: pre_login_prompt_usage
rules.value: pre_login_prompt is accepted for deny, allow and require; with allow (or require) and no organization, /authorize shows the organization prompt

rules.name: post_login_prompt_oidc
rules.value: post_login_prompt requires oidc_conformant true; otherwise 400

rules.name: discovery_methods_rule
rules.value: organization_discovery_methods only while organization_require_behavior is pre_login_prompt; Plan 29 always shows the name field

rules.name: authorize_errors
rules.value: pre-authentication refusals redirect invalid_request with our own error_description per cause (unknown/invalid ID, not allowed for client, required, must be an ID, invitation not supported)

rules.name: empty_organization_param
rules.value: organization= with an empty value is treated as absent

rules.name: connection_not_enabled
rules.value: no /authorize error for a connection= that is unknown or not enabled for the organization; the hosted login offers only the client/organization intersection and refuses authentication through any other connection

rules.name: client_credentials_organization
rules.value: client_credentials with organization stays invalid_request until Plan 30 (observed for the reserved Management API audience); client organization_usage does not affect client credentials

rules.name: connections_alias_ruling
rules.value: /organizations/{id}/connections is Early Access in the public reference (OAS x-release-lifecycle EA; guide says the new organization connection endpoints are EA), not a documented GA alias. Task 5 ruling: served in Plan 29 for the Deploy CLI 9.1.0, from the same links as enabled_connections; is_enabled and the access levels are fixed at the observed defaults and not stored

rules.name: member_order
rules.value: member and role-member listings ordered by user_id ascending; checkpoint cursor is the last user_id (not observed)

rules.name: picker
rules.value: post-login picker shows at most 20 eligible organizations sorted by display name; one eligible selects it; none but exactly one auto-membership organization for the connection selects it with membership; else access_denied

rules.name: par_binding
rules.value: a pushed request binds organization; request_uri cannot add or override it; the code records the organization ID

rules.name: organization_client_grants_read
rules.value: GET /organizations/{id}/client-grants (read:organization_client_grants) returns an empty list in the documented offset shape until Plan 30 adds organization client grants; POST and DELETE stay deferred

tools.name: auth0-cli
tools.exposes: orgs list/show/create/update/delete/open; members list; roles list; roles members list; invitations (Plan 30). Uses page/per_page with include_totals=true, GET enabled_connections via go-auth0; update re-sends whole branding and metadata built client-side (consistent with PATCH replace).

tools.name: node-auth0
tools.exposes: organizations list/create/get/getByName/update/delete/search; enabledConnections list/add/get/update/delete; connections list/create/get/update/delete (EA, served from the enabled_connections links); members list/create/delete; members.roles list/assign/delete; members.effectiveRoles list (checkpoint, sources); roles.members list (checkpoint); plus Plan 30/38 resources (invitations, clientGrants, clients, discoveryDomains, groups).

tools.name: auth0-deploy-cli
tools.exposes: organizations with name, display_name, branding, metadata, connections, client_grants, token_quota, discovery_domains, clients. Connections go through the EA /organizations/{id}/connections resource and export lists organization client grants unconditionally (both served in Plan 29 by the Task 5 ruling); a 404/501 empties the organizations export. No members or member roles.
